description.purpose: A character in a shared world: a world adapter and a handset around a referenced `simple-agent@2`, the agent of the colony the figure lives in. The world's tools are client tools of each turn, the handset speaks to a colony the way a human channel does, and the role (`human-sim` or `npc`) sets the agent's frame. The figure carries the agent's contract lanes on its own rim; its identity is its own entry in the colony's affinity, its keys come from the colony's access. Since 1.0.1 (#1292) the template pins `simple-agent@1.0.1`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.2 (#1294) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.1`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.3 (#1298) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.2`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.4 (#1300) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.3`; it is the third digit. Since 1.0.5 (#1303) the template pins `simple-agent@1.1.4`; it is the third digit. Since 2.0.0 (#1311) the template carries this change and pins `simple-agent@2.1.0`; it is the first digit. Since 2.0.1 (#1315) the template carries this change and pins `simple-agent@2.1.1`; it is the third digit. Since 2.0.2 (#1320) the template pins `simple-agent@2.1.2`; it is the third digit. Since 2.0.3 (#1332) the template pins `simple-agent@2.2.1`; it is the third digit.
description.use_when: One instance per character, each in a colony of its own or in a player's own colony.
description.not_in_scope: No model or memory of its own (the agent's), no grant and no access (the colony's), no world knowledge, no deadline of its own.
examples: obs -> turn -> call* -> intent; night -> close of every session of the day -> night
